metadata.description: Claude Code plugins: engineering practice, frontend and UI, infrastructure and machine operations, delivery operations and governance, marketing and content, and vendor and tool operations.

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: Project-agnostic engineering practice and workstation operations: operating principles, scope discipline, incremental implementation, code review, security and threat modeling, performance, observability, git workflow, PR lifecycle and shipping; plus disk reclaim, hidden-service discovery, safe repo removal, failing-fleet triage, per-PR preview environments, local bring-up, AWS and DNS infrastructure, false verification signals, session handoffs, verifying a document before citing it, and cross-source work summaries and prioritized work queues, and wiring social OAuth providers whose client secret is shown exactly once; plus accessibility engineering, Tailwind v4 conventions, and reviewing UI against web interface guidelines.

plugins.name: vendor-ops
plugins.description: Vendor and tool operations for the systems a team coordinates in rather than builds: issue trackers and knowledge wikis. Confirming a tracker connection points at the right workspace before writing, restraint about whose tickets you touch, filing a document in the collection its own taxonomy asks for, and the wiki write calls that report success and change nothing. Every workspace value comes from a profile.

plugins.name: delivery-skills
plugins.description: Delivery operations and governance: deploy, cloud build, QA, npm publish, dependency triage, planning, retros, reset and sunset — plus two chains with separation of duties. A trust chain (posture review, evidence investigation, remediation review, founder brief) and a delivery pipeline (shape work, repo orient, implement story, delivery review, release readiness), each step verified by someone other than its author.

plugins.name: marketing-skills
plugins.description: Marketing and content practice: writing and editing marketing copy, stripping the patterns that make prose read as AI-written, designing a landing page, conversion optimization for pages and forms, popups, email sequences, A/B testing, analytics and measurement, technical SEO audits, AI/answer-engine SEO, programmatic SEO, structured data, marketing psychology, and tearing down a competitor's site for evidence. Most skills are from Corey Haines' MIT-licensed marketingskills library; see README for per-skill provenance.

plugins.name: frontend-skills
plugins.description: Frontend and UI engineering: composition over configuration, accessibility by default, Tailwind v4 conventions, a component reference library, scroll-linked motion, reviewing a surface against web interface guidelines, and designing or auditing screens against a design contract the workspace supplies.

plugins.name: infra-skills
plugins.description: Infrastructure and machine operations: AWS and Terraform, DNS delegation, mail authentication records, Google Workspace SSO cutover, social OAuth providers, per-PR preview environments, GCP resource sweeps, plus workstation operations — disk reclaim, hidden services, failing-fleet triage, safe repo removal and cold local bring-up.
